title: SQLite — Final Assessment Blueprint

topic_distribution.area: Foundations, setup, relational model and SQL fundamentals
Functions, schema, constraints, data changes and transactions
Joins, advanced queries, indexing and application integration
Reliability, security, advanced features, QA and production design

outcomes: Model relational data and choose SQLite with an explicit workload rationale.
Write correct SQL and design constraints, relationships and transactions.
Integrate a safe application data-access layer and handle failure.
Explain performance, concurrency, backup, migration, version and build trade-offs.
Produce a tested and documented SQLite project.
grading_policy: Protected knowledge checks can use the existing assessment mechanism. Architecture, performance, recovery, native API and project evidence require human review unless a secure, isolated execution environment and relevant automated tests are configured.
remediation: Review the linked module, complete the related practical exercise, reproduce the example on a disposable database and document the corrected reasoning.
certificate_policy: This content package does not issue certificates; certification requires the platform’s backend-verified passing-exam workflow.
